paragraphs.text: Instead of comfort, being now at death's door, he had but them that mocked at him, and discouraged him.

paragraphs.text: He reasons with God as a man beside himself, so that his cause might be brought to light.

paragraphs.text: God has made all the world speak of me, because of my afflictions.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: That is, when they see the godly punished: but in the end they will come to understanding and know what will be the reward of the hypocrite.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That is, will not be discouraged, considering that the godly are punished as well as the wicked.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Job speaks to the three who came to comfort him.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: That is, have brought me sorrow instead of comfort.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Though I should hope to come from adversity to prosperity, as your discourse pretends.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: I have no more hope in father, mother, sister, or any worldly thing: for the dust and worms will be to me instead of them.
paragraphs.label: o

paragraphs.text: All worldly hope and prosperity fail which you say, are only signs of God's favour but seeing that these things perish, I set my hope in God and in the life everlasting.
